More of my work

Launching Jio Maps APIs from zero

Jio Platforms · 0→1 launch

Enterprises needed Indian routing, search and geocoding they could build on. I defined the MVP, pricing hypotheses, onboarding flows and enterprise GTM.

12+ B2B customers and ~₹2 Cr ARR.

Making ETAs something customers could trust

Jio Platforms · navigation and fleet

Unreliable ETAs were triggering SLA penalties. I led the move to ML-based real-time traffic forecasting and set a multi-quarter roadmap across accuracy, latency, cost and monetisation.

ETA accuracy 75% → 90%, SLA breaches down 23 pts, penalties down 25%, operating costs down 12%.

Giving fleet managers their hours back with GenAI

Jio Platforms · fleet intelligence

Fleet teams spent hours compiling reports by hand. I took a GenAI operations system from concept to production that automates reporting and surfaces insights.

8+ hours saved per customer, every week.

Helping people find their way in hospitals

Jio Platforms · indoor maps, 35+ hospitals

Visitors were getting lost and we couldn't see where. I designed instrumentation for wayfinding success, route deviation and dwell time, then ran fixes off the data.

Navigation completion up ~13%, DAU up 27%.
